headline: Your kindness makes a round trip
fortune: You will help someone with a tiny thing, then find your own tiny problem already solved. The universe enjoys symmetry.

headline: The missing thing waves
fortune: Something you thought was lost will be sitting in an obvious place, looking innocent. Please question it firmly.

headline: One detail makes their day
fortune: You will remember a small detail about someone, and their whole face will light up. Mithu takes no credit for once.

headline: Your plant grows applause
fortune: The plant you nearly gave up on uncurls one bright leaf. It has forgiven you and would like better watering.

headline: The biscuit survives
fortune: Your next biscuit survives a dangerously long chai dunk. Some victories deserve a respectful silence.

headline: You choose the perfect mango
fortune: With no evidence whatsoever, you pick the sweetest mango. The family promotes you to fruit oracle.

headline: The button stays loyal
fortune: You fix one loose button before leaving. It behaves all day and never reveals how close to chaos you were.

headline: Two lines become a keepsake
fortune: A tiny note you leave for someone stays on their fridge much longer than expected. Your words found a home.

headline: The jar makes you famous
fortune: You open the stubborn jar everyone surrendered to. Enjoy your brief and completely deserved hero status.

headline: Five early minutes pay back
fortune: You leave five minutes early and catch sunlight turning an ordinary lane golden. The day bows before beginning.

headline: Your silly song gets an encore
fortune: You teach someone a ridiculous tune, then hear them humming it later. Congratulations: joy is now contagious.

headline: The wobble finally loses
fortune: One folded scrap makes the annoying chair perfectly steady. Sit like a ruler who has restored order.

headline: One pinch earns applause
fortune: Your accidental extra pinch makes dinner better. Nod wisely when everyone asks for the secret.
